@name: Mercenary
@slug: mercenary
@source: character_law
@category: RMFRP Character Law
@default_cost: 56
@description:
 [Lifestyle] A mercenary is an independent soldier who works for the highest
 paying employer. Most armies have at least a few mercenaries to fill out
 their ranks (and some are comprised mostly of mercenaries). Most mercenaries
 are wellversed in more than one culture and have a good working knowledge of
 warfare. Time to Acquire: 80 months. Starting Money: normal + d10
 (open-ended).
